title: Deliverable 638799: Spend Requests in Base App
summary: Spend Requests allow users to create requisitions for planned expenses and link them to journal entries and purchase documents for automatic updates during posting.
key_points: New Spend Request table and pages enable tracking of spending requisitions
Journal and purchase documents can reference spend requests which update on posting
Modified general journal check and posting logic to process spend request links
Feature provides foundation for approval workflows and expense management
Implementation is partial and awaits additional approval and validation features
